registry.HOUSE-OCC: Whole-sign house/palace occupied -> domain via HOUSE_DOMAIN; prominence high if >=2 occupants else medium; polarity from the sum of occupant scores
registry.JY-KARAKA: Parashari naisargika karakas: Sun->D1,D2; Moon->D5,D8; Mercury->D8; Jupiter->D3,D6,D9; Venus->D4
registry.W-SIGNIF: Hellenistic planetary significations (Valens I.1): Sun->D1,D2; Moon->D5,D7; Mercury->D8; Venus->D4; Jupiter->D3,D6,D9
registry.JY-SCORE: natural nature (Ju/Ve +1, Me +0.5 or -0.5 if with a malefic, Moon +0.5 if 72-288 deg from Sun else -0.5, Sun -0.5, Ma/Sa/Ra/Ke -1) + sign dignity (exalt/moola/own +1, friend +0.5, neutral 0, enemy -0.5, debil -1) + navamsa (own/exalt +0.5, debil -0.5, vargottama +0.5) - 0.5 per malefic sharing the sign
registry.W-SCORE: nature (Ju/Ve +1, Moon +0.5, Me/Sun 0, Ma/Sa -1) + essential dignity (domicile/exaltation +1, detriment/fall -1, sect-triplicity +0.5, other triplicity/bound +0.25, face +0.1) + sect (benefic of sect +0.5, benefic contrary -0.5, malefic of sect +0.5, malefic contrary -0.5) + station retrograde -0.5 / station direct +0.25
registry.ZW-SCORE: major star brightness 庙/旺 +1, 得/利 +0.5, 平 0, 陷/不 -1; 化禄/权/科 +1, 化忌 -1.5; auspicious minors (左辅 右弼 文昌 文曲 天魁 天钺 禄存 天马) +0.5; malefic minors (擎羊 陀罗 火星 铃星 地空 地劫) -0.75; empty palace borrows the opposite palace's major stars at half weight (借星安宫)
registry.ZW-PALACE: 命宫->D1, 官禄->D2, 财帛->D3, 夫妻->D4, 田宅/父母->D5, 子女->D6, 疾厄->D7, 福德->D9; D8 only if 文昌/文曲 sit in 命宫, 身宫 or 官禄
registry.BZ-D1: Day Master strength verdicts (BZ-DM-1 weighted vs seasonal) agree -> that polarity; disagree -> mixed
registry.BZ-D2: Officer/Seven Killings stars visible -> prominence; 伤官见官 (Hurting Officer and Direct Officer both visible) -> mixed
registry.BZ-D3: Wealth element (the one the Day Master controls) share >= 25% -> prominence high; weak DM carrying wealth (财多身弱) -> mixed; share < 15% -> neutral
registry.BZ-D4: spouse palace = day branch (spouse star: Wealth for a male chart, Officer/Killings for a female chart); punishment/destruction/clash/harm on it -> mixed; only combinations -> positive; none -> neutral
registry.BZ-D5: Resource star on a visible stem -> positive; combined away by a stem combination -> mixed; none visible -> neutral
registry.BZ-D6: children palace = hour pillar; children star = Officer/Killings (male) or Eating/Hurting (female); visible with conflict (伤官见官 male, 枭神夺食 female) -> mixed; visible -> positive; not visible -> neutral
registry.BZ-D8: Output stars (食神/伤官) visible or >=3 hidden, plus Resource present -> positive, high
registry.POLARITY: positive if net >= +1 and no component <= -1; negative if net <= -1 and no component >= +1; mixed if components >= +1 and <= -1 both present; otherwise neutral (does not vote)
registry.GRADE: STRONG = 3 clusters same polarity; MODERATE = 2 same; WEAK = only one cluster voting or no agreement; DIVERGENT = any positive-vs-negative conflict between clusters (takes precedence); INSUFFICIENT = none voting
registry.STABILITY: outer scenario (+/-30 min) counts only facts stable over the whole interval; inner (+/-15 min) counts facts stable over +/-15. Sensitive facts are displayed as alternatives and never vote.
registry.JY-REFERENCE: Jyotisha houses are counted from the Lagna when the Lagna sign is stable over the whole uncertainty interval; otherwise from Chandra Lagna (Moon sign). The unused frame is shown as a non-voting secondary view.
registry.W-HOUSES: Western whole-sign house projections vote only when the Ascendant sign is stable over the whole interval.
registry.CLUSTER: Jyotisha; Western/Hellenistic; Sinic (BaZi + Zi Wei pooled, one vote). Maya/Tibetan never vote.
registry.TIMING: a cluster activates a domain in a window if any of its declared techniques does (one vote per cluster): Jyotisha: Mahadasha lord's karaka domains + its house from the JY-REFERENCE frame; Western: profected house number; Sinic: Da Yun stem/branch Ten-God domains (Wealth->D3,D4 male; Officer/Killings->D2,D6; Output->D8; Resource->D5,D8; Companion/Rob->D1) and Zi Wei decadal palace domain
